content: {"phoneNote":"The first screen works well, but the opening-hours bar chart stretches six near-identical rows down a whole screen and the same hours return in the footer.","desktopNote":"The price list leaves the right half empty under 'Žalno cvetje' and the hours section ends in a dead band, so the middle of the page feels unfinished.","phone":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":3},"desktop":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":2,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":3},"fixes":["Replace the six-row hours chart with a compact Mon–Fri / Sat table and keep only one hours block on the page (drop the footer copy or the section).","On desktop, lay the price list in three equal columns (Šopki, Žalno cvetje, Dostava) so the right half isn't empty, and trim the gap below the hours.","Give the desktop hero image the full height of the text column and reduce the empty strip under the hero so the first screen feels composed."],"blockers":["Opening hours appear twice: in the 'Kdaj sem odprta' section and again verbatim in the footer 'Delovni čas' on both phone and desktop."]}
